fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 2 at 22bd296a. Read internal/textref and the fix diff. go test -count=1 -v ./internal/textref passes. TestFind covers: a reference starts at text start or after whitespace, ( or [; handles, IDs and 4+ char prefixes are found; darin@hey.com, checkout@v7, '@key' and @@alpha hold none. TestResolve: references, @{<ID>} included, become @{<full ID>}; @{BOGUS} and @nope come back unresolved with their offsets. New TestResolveLiteralFullID: an @@{<full ID>} escape and an unmapped @{<full ID>} are returned (Escaped set) and stored without braces, so they never read back as references. TestFormat: a live node shows @handle; a retired or missing node shows @{<full ID>}; stored @{ID}, @{BOGUS}, @{<full ID>} and @{...} show as @@{...}; stored @word shows @@word. Fuzz runs: FuzzRoundTrip for 45s, about 2.27M execs, which now also checks that every stored reference came from lookup; FuzzStoredRoundTrip for 45s, about 1.92M execs. Neither failed. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/text-refs passes, including the new text-refs-write.txtar cases: a strict @@{<full ID>} is refused with a usage error, and a lenient note stores the brace-less form with fold-ok. make fmt-check vet test passes. make self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered (missing critic actor pages, index.md). Those come from the earlier critic chore commits; this commit touches no .rhiza file.
